description_en: Queries Layer 7 CC rules by calling DescribeLayer7CCRules
kebab_example: aliyun ddoscoo describe-layer7-cc-rules --source-ip 1.1.1.1 --resource-group-id test --domain www.aliyun.com --offset 0 --page-size 10 --api-version 2017-12-28 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeLayer7CCRules

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The start index position, which specifies the result number from which to start returning results. 

If you do not specify this parameter, results are returned starting from the 0th result
parameters.help_zh:
开始索引位置，即从第几个结果开始返回。 

若不传入该参数，则从第0个结果开始返回
parameters.name: offset

parameters.help_en: The number of results to return on each page. Maximum value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 分页大小，即每页显示过少个结果。最大值10。
parameters.name: page_size
